newsitem.title: USA: BOXING-FIGHTER BOWE LEAVES MARINES AFTER 10 DAYS, MANAGER SAYS.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-FIGHTER BOWE LEAVES MARINES AFTER 10 DAYS, MANAGER SAYS.

text.p: Former heavyweight champion Riddick Bowe has left the U.S. Marines after just 10 days in military service, the fighter's manager said on Friday.
Manager Rock Newman told CNN in an interview that Bowe was going through agony being away from his wife and children.
"Once he got there it was more than he expected," Newman said.
